title: Late-Cancellation Fee Carried by an In-Person Appointments Visit
content:
The late-cancellation fee an In-Person Appointments visit carries is the visit type's late-cancellation fee when the visit's cancellation is recorded with timing late, and nothing when it is recorded with any other timing.

The figure is reckoned in one order: the starting amount of the fee is raised first, sums added to the fee are then added to that figure, and the fee the visit carries is rounded to the cent only at the end. For a cancellation recorded with timing late the starting amount is the visit type's late-cancellation fee from the fee schedule.

### By timing recorded on the appointment

| Timing recorded on the cancelled visit | Late-cancellation fee the visit carries |
|---|---|
| Late | The visit type's late-cancellation fee, reckoned as above |
| Timely | Nothing |
| Clinic initiated | Nothing |

### Worked figures (hypothetical visits)

- A Specialist Consultation cancelled with timing late: starting amount $40.00, the visit type's late-cancellation fee; rounded to the cent, the fee the visit carries is $40.00.
- An Advanced Imaging Appointment cancelled with timing late: $100.00.
- The same Advanced Imaging Appointment had its cancellation been recorded as timely: nothing, $0.00.

The timing read is the one recorded on the appointment itself; the fee the visit carries follows that record.
